title.value: Convex Potential Flows: Universal Probability Distributions with Optimal Transport and Convex Optimization
title.justification: The title can be deduced from the main introduction of the paper which discusses 'Convex Potential Flows' as a primary focus and their relation to optimal transport and convex optimization.

analysis.description: This paper introduces Convex Potential Flows (CP-Flow), an invertible model parameterized by a convex potential, which is inspired by optimal transport theory. It discusses the theoretical foundations that prove CP-Flow as universal and optimal in the transport sense and emphasizes efficient inversion via convex optimization. Empirical results show CP-Flow's competitive performance in density estimation and variational inference benchmarks.

type.justification: The paper contains experimental results and comparisons with existing models, as well as theoretical analyses, indicating a blend of theory and empirical evaluation. It emphasizes empirical results showcasing the competitive performance of the proposed model.
type.quote: Our empirical results show that CP-Flow performs competitively on standard benchmarks of density estimation and variational inference.
